verdict.rationale: Databricks documents background automations: SQL alerts monitor query results and deliver notifications automatically, Auto Loader and Structured Streaming incrementally process new data as it arrives, and Lakeflow ETL pipelines are deployed for orchestration. Genie Code adds an autonomous agent that plans, runs code and fixes errors, though it asks for approval before using tools. missing for 10: explicit job scheduling/trigger documentation, evidence of AI agents running unattended in the background (Genie Code is approval-gated and workspace-interactive), independent or hands-on corroboration.
